card.name: Words before a record release
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas in music-history text, right where the next word could be about issuing or releasing a recording or work (e.g. 'recorded ... for', 'originally', 'premier of').

modes.label: Recording credits
modes.description: Linking word after a piece or performer where a label or release is expected.
modes.example: cellists<< for>> Columbia. During his period at SEMA

modes.label: Issued on LP or CD
modes.description: Words in a sentence about works being issued and reissued on records.
modes.example: these were<< originally>> issued on LP's and later reissued

modes.label: Work credited to author
modes.description: Preposition or comma after a work title, naming who made or commissioned it.
